$comment: Editorial DTP comparison matrix behind /docs/paged/compare. Ordinal 0-3 editorial scores on a dated snapshot, NOT vendor benchmarks. Roadmap-not-shipped Paged capabilities use pagedPlanned:true and are scored honestly, not as present. Update with `pnpm update:comparison` (researches current facts via Claude Opus) or by hand — then bump `snapshot`. Competitor tools carry a `researched` date; Paged's scores stay editorial but each row names the registry features (`paged.chapters` / `paged.features`) or facts it rests on, and check:comparison fails a score of 2 or more whose backing is planned, failing or less than half verified.

tools.name: DesignCraft (ArtCraft)
tools.note: Open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0), pre-alpha; added 2026-10-12

rows.note: Paged's engine is {fact:license.engine} and its editor {fact:license.editor}; Scribus is GPL. Affinity is free-of-charge but proprietary and vendor-governed (Canva). DesignCraft (ArtCraft) is MIT OR Apache-2.0 and free.

Paged's .paged is always a valid IDML (ZIP) package. InDesign's .indd is closed (IDML is its interchange form). .qxp and .af are proprietary; Scribus .sla is open XML but app-specific. DesignCraft has its own documented native format.

rows.dimension: Round-trips IDML with the InDesign ecosystem
rows.note: InDesign defines IDML. Paged reads and writes it natively. QuarkXPress opens IDML and exports print layouts as IDML (conversions are not identical). Affinity imports IDML, and INDD natively since September 2026, but cannot export IDML; Scribus imports IDML and IDMS but cannot write them. DesignCraft imports and exports IDML; its own gap list says the round trip is not yet measured on real InDesign files.

Paged exposes a sandboxed paged.* ECMAScript surface (emerging). InDesign has ExtendScript/UXP; QuarkXPress has JavaScript and AppleScript; Scribus has Python; Affinity added in-app scripting in its September 2026 update. DesignCraft drives every command over a JSON control channel, an MCP server and a headless CLI; it has no document scripting language.

Paged ships a public plugin SDK (emerging). InDesign's SDK is mature but closed/paid; Quark has XTensions (the XTensions Developer Kit); Affinity has no plugin platform. DesignCraft documents no plugin system.

InDesign leans on InDesign Server + EasyCatalog/priint; QuarkXPress has QuarkXPress Server. Affinity has Data Merge in the app and, since September 2026, scripting, but no headless output. Scribus runs Python scripts. Paged's command line and engine service open IDML, run scripts, merge records and export PDF/X-4 with no desktop app; Data Merge from the command line is experimental and the batch runner emits pages, not files. DesignCraft's headless CLI renders and drives documents; data merge is not documented.

Paged renders with WebGPU and runs in the browser as well as headless. The incumbents are desktop apps (InDesign adds a server product and, since 21.0, text editing in the browser). DesignCraft runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD and in the browser via WebAssembly, with a headless CLI.

The honest gap: Paged is an emerging platform, not at the layout/typography depth of 25-year-old incumbents. Treated as baseline because every serious tool clears it. DesignCraft (pre-alpha) has a Knuth–Plass composer, threaded stories and styles, but threading text by hand is still its alpha blocker.

Scribus is notably strong here. Paged color/print production is emerging; several pieces are on the roadmap, not shipped. DesignCraft exports PDF/X-4 and PDF/A-2b with CMYK, spot colours, bleed and crop marks (per its README; pre-alpha).

verdicts.choose: Choose InDesign for the deepest layout toolset, ecosystem, and talent pool — if a subscription and a closed format are acceptable.
Choose QuarkXPress for long-document and structured/enterprise publishing on a perpetual licence or a subscription.
Choose Affinity for a free, polished one-off layout app — but accept a proprietary format, no IDML export, scripting that only arrived in September 2026, and no plugins.
Choose Scribus for mature, open-source layout with excellent print/color output today.
Watch DesignCraft (ArtCraft) for a free, MIT/Apache-licensed InDesign-style desktop app that agents can drive over MCP — it is pre-alpha today, and has no plugin platform.
Choose Paged for an open, IDML-compatible, scriptable, automation-first foundation — accepting that layout/print depth is still emerging.
